title: fix(ui): avoid model setup reactive-read diagnostics
body:

All 170 production files were parsed for the scope census. The cleanup registrations belong to immediate request/DOM resource primitives; ordinary component cleanup is zero. Preview and composer intentionally have independent readiness. Cron belongs to the recipes lane. The async/action recipe is absent at this base, so those conversions remain pending. Model Setup's five keyed entity lists belong to #179275 and remain counted until landed. This diagnostic fix does not claim any family as migrated.

## What Problem This Solves

Opening or refreshing Model Setup emits Solid 2's `STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED` diagnostic from route synchronization.

## User Impact

No rendered behavior changes. Model Setup keeps editable drafts and focus during rescans, and still waits for route data before starting detection.

## Why This Change Was Made

Model Setup's effect already captured route data, but discarded that value and reread the reactive prop during its apply phase. Solid 2 reports `STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED` during the existing refresh flow. Pass the captured value to the initial synchronization instead. Later selection and Gateway callbacks explicitly read current route data, preserving their dispatch-time behavior. The route argument is required so a captured `undefined` cannot fall back to another reactive read.

The existing refresh test now rejects the diagnostic while retaining its draft and focus assertions. An additional case covers mounting without route data and confirms that no detection request starts. No JSX, CSS, host tags, request authority, or lazy boundary changes.

## Evidence

| Proof | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Baseline refresh reproduction | Existing failed-rescan case fails specifically on `STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED` |
| Targeted refresh suite | 4/4 pass on the final source; baseline absent-route case also passes |
| UI tsrs and targeted formatting | Pass |
| Targeted lint | Inherited `eslint(max-lines)`: base 712, head 709, limit 700 |
| Production Knip | Pass; no imports or exports changed |
| Independent review | Scoped-clean, no P0–P2 findings; supplied diff/source-context review, without independent test execution |
| Base and head UI builds | Pass on both sides; same machine and identical embedded build identity |
| Strict performance | Base and head exceed the same startup/Chat absolute caps. Startup 331,230 → 331,243 B (+13); Chat 1,500,632 → 1,500,687 B (+55); New Session 1,018,037 → 1,018,069 B (+32). Over-cap deltas are ≤64 B; startup CSS stays 40,439 B / 1 request. |
| Visual proof | No rendered change; existing synthetic draft/focus assertions retained |

Production LOC in Model Setup: 4,820 → 4,817 (-3). Touched production file: 751 → 748 (-3); touched test file: 188 → 202 (+14). Whole Pages B production scope: 36,904 → 36,901 (-3). The helper now takes only route data and reads its plain Gateway snapshot internally. Removing forwarding closures keeps captured-versus-live reads explicit while slightly reducing production code. Refactor checklist: one external-synchronization effect before and after; zero render effects, untrack, listeners, DOM queries, flush, escaped owner APIs, or hand-built class strings in the touched production file.
